project_name: Stack Berry Hill Data Center Campus
aliases: Southern Virginia Megasite at Berry Hill data center campus
status_detail: Danville-Pittsylvania Regional Industrial Facility Authority approved a local performance agreement in May 2026; county supervisors later supported the project. Reports cite about $100B over 30 years and 2,500 jobs, contingent on Virginia data center tax treatment.
notes: Official county site confirms Berry Hill megasite characteristics; project specifics from RIFA/news coverage.

status_detail: County 2024 year-in-review says supervisors approved rezoning of 945 acres in Ringgold for the county first data center; local news reports Planning Commission recommendation and site off US 58/State Road 735.
notes: Capacity not found in quick county/news review.

aliases: Balico gas plant and data center MegaCampus
status_detail: Balico proposed a hyperscale data center campus with gas-fired power generation; advocacy and news sources report the Board of Supervisors denied the rezoning request on April 15, 2025 after earlier larger and revised applications.
notes: Capacity is associated gas plant size, not IT load; original proposal referenced 84 data centers on about 2,200 acres, later scaled down.

status_detail: No county/city-level data center project found in official website and targeted web/news searches.
notes: Search hits were regional subsea-cable/data-center strategy language or jobs in nearby Hampton/Norfolk/Virginia Beach, not a Poquoson project.

status_detail: Globalinx told the Portsmouth Broadband Authority it was planning/building a backup data center in Portsmouth and was exploring 700 Port Centre Parkway; no capacity or timeline disclosed.
notes: Portsmouth economic development site confirms fiber ring/data-center opportunity context; project details from DCD/tracker.

aliases: Newport Equities Powhatan data center campus
status_detail: Powhatan Board approvals cover adjacent 120-acre and 60-acre parcels, creating a 180-acre campus approved for over 2 million sq ft; JLL says Dominion will energize initial deployment of 365 MW.
notes: Earlier 2024 approval described 119.9 acres/three data centers/1.525M sq ft and estimated $2.7B; 2025 follow-on added adjacent acreage.

project_name: HIT Park Data Center Project Pegasus
status_detail: County/IDA agreements with AVAIO contemplate potential purchase and development of the 280-acre HIT Park as a multi-building data center campus; county FAQ says no site plans, building permits, or construction plans had been submitted/approved as of July 31, 2026.
notes: County FAQ references up to 300 MW, about $2.4B developer investment plus $4B+ tenant/operator equipment potential.

status_detail: No Virginia Prince George County data center project found in official county and targeted searches.
notes: Official business incentives page lists Virginia Data Center Retail Sales & Use Tax Exemption as an incentive, but searches did not identify a local project; many hits were Prince George’s County, Maryland and excluded.

project_name: NRV Commerce Park data center prospect
aliases: New River Valley Commerce Park data center
status_detail: Pulaski County/New River Valley leaders are working with a developer to prepare Commerce Park for a possible data center; reports state the site is industrial-zoned and no end user has been identified.
notes: NRV Commerce Park site lists Data Center/Information Technology as an ideal target; UDO permits data centers in several districts. Project remains exploratory/prospect without named end user.

status_detail: No data center project physically in Radford city found in official/local search.
notes: Radford appears in regional discussion because the city is one of the jurisdictions sharing ownership/revenue of NRV Commerce Park, but the possible site is in Pulaski County, not Radford city.
